newsitem.title: SWEDEN: French Lyreco to buy Dorab of Sweden.
newsitem.headline: French Lyreco to buy Dorab of Sweden.

text.p: Swedish office supplier Dorab AB said on Tuesday that French rival, privately owned Lyreco, would buy the Swedish firm in an international expansion plan.
Dorab's operations have grown sharply in the past few years and its 1996 turnover totalled 600 million crowns.
After the acquisition Lyreco will have subsidiaries in 10 European countries and in Canada. Currently, Lyreco has 4,000 employees.
"Lyreco's ambition is to become the sector's leading company internationally and the purchase of Dorab is a step in that strategy," Dorab said in a statement.
The acquisition is conditioned on approval from authorities, Dorab said.
